title: Pioneer Trail original authored runtime assets
creator: ContractorKeith
redistributionRequirements: Retain the MIT copyright and permission notice with redistributed source or substantial portions of these assets.
delivery: Original TypeScript mesh recipes and deterministic texture generators are compiled into the local application bundle. They generate geometry and texture pixels locally; there are no external asset fetches or runtime paid services.

assets.source: Original authored parametric geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: New release mesh: planked bed and sideboards, bent hoop canvas shell, seams and ties, bench, steps, tailgate, metal hardware, axles and suspension.

assets.source: Original authored geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Four separate rotating wooden felloes, iron tires, fourteen spokes, hubs and retaining rings; rotation uses signed traveled distance.

assets.source: Original authored cross-section lofts and appendage geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Continuous rump-to-muzzle body surface, tapered swept horns, ears, dewlap, facial features, tails, articulated limbs and split hooves. Two coat variants; gait follows actual distance and terrain contact.

assets.source: Original authored curves and geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Curved wooden yoke, U-bows, iron fittings, pole link, cheek straps and sagged leather reins connected to driver position.

assets.source: Original authored cross-section lofts and articulated geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Continuous deer body/neck/head, branched antlers, ears, muzzle, eyes, tail, articulated legs and split hooves; deterministic world paths and persistent carcass/collection state.

assets.source: Original authored cross-section loft and appendage geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Continuous rabbit body/head, long inset ears, rear haunches, front legs, tail, facial details and speed-driven hopping.

assets.source: Original authored clothing and anatomical geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Shaped coat torso, bent sleeves, hands, boots, belt/buckle, lapels, pocket, buttons, scarf, facial features, broad-brim hat and subtle idle movement; two clothing palettes.

assets.source: Original authored geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Open canvas tent with bedding/poles/guy ropes/stakes, trade awning/table, crates, bottles, cloth, kettle, long gun and original stroke-letter provisions sign.

assets.source: Original authored geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Staved casks with hoops/lids/bungs, slatted crates with nails, sacks and rope ties, blanket rolls with straps, bucket and spade.

assets.source: Original deterministic pixel-generation algorithms in this repository; no photos or third-party textures
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: 256px wood grain/knots, woven canvas, leather, animal hide, skin, bark, earth and stone albedo/bump textures; metal and cloth PBR material definitions. Albedo uses sRGB and bump maps use non-color data.

assets.source: Original deterministic terrain recipes and mesh generation in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Plains, woodland/river valley, mountain pass and desert palettes/relief, trail ruts, actual carved side channel and crossing, matched triangle interpolation for collision, chunked mesh and distant relief.

assets.source: Original authored deterministic geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Branch-and-frond pines, irregular broadleaf crowns and trunks, curved grass tufts, cattails/reeds, ground outcrops and visible crossing hazards; instanced and culled in patches.

assets.source: Original geometry, GLSL and deterministic textures in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Animated PBR river surface and shoreline foam, procedural sky/clouds/sun/stars, generated reflection environment, day/night lighting, fog, rain, snow and ground snow tint.

assets.source: Original geometry and deterministic particle textures in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Stone ring, charred logs, soft additive flame sprites, drifting smoke, rising embers and flickering point light; rain reduces flame and firelight.

assets.source: Original authored period prop geometry in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Locally authored rifle, fishing rod, reel, bobber, and line geometry used by the hunt and fishing activities; no third-party model or texture files.

assets.source: Original Web Audio synthesis and scheduling code in this repository
assets.creator: ContractorKeith
assets.modifications: Procedural noise, oscillator, step, wagon, water, campfire, wind, and animal ambience generated locally after user gesture; no recorded samples or external audio files.

assets.source: Natural Earth 1:50m physical land and rivers/lake-centerlines vectors; source and retrieval record in docs/MAP.md
assets.creator: Natural Earth
assets.modifications: Geometry-clipped offline subset for the western trail map; projected locally with campaign route landmarks. It is not a historical trail alignment.
assets.redistributionRequirements: Natural Earth data are public domain; retain the source record and attribution in docs/MAP.md.
